newsitem.title: USA: Auto dealer Rick Hendrick indicted - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Auto dealer Rick Hendrick indicted - newspaper.

text.p: A lawyer for Rick Hendrick, the largest auto dealer in the country and NASCAR racing giant, said Hendrick would plead innocent to federal charges of conspiracy, mail fraud and money laundering, according to the Thursday edition of The Charlotte Observer.

He was indicted on Wednesday by a federal grand jury in Asheville, N.C., for allegedly bribing executives of Honda Motor Co Ltd's American Honda Motor Co in return for favorable treatment in getting dealerships and hot-selling cars, the newspaper said.

"As Rick Hendrick has always maintained, he never paid any emloyee of Honda in order to obtain favorable treatment of any kind. Rick Hendrick will plead not guilty and vigorously defend the charges against him," attorney Harold Bender told the paper.
Hendrick faces 13 counts of money laundering, one count of mail fraud, and one count of conspiracy.
The government also indicted Hendrick's brother John, who operates dealerships in the Carolinas, on a conspiracy charge.
Hendrick operates 89 U.S. dealerships selling a variety of car brands.
